referee_caveats_inferred: The table lists SMM 2 as C-type at 72 K and the VLA1623A circumbinary structure as C-type in Class 0; reconcile these entries with the reported earliest 163 K structure and absence of Class 0 detections.
Verify the printed inclination formula against the inclinations actually used for selection.
The age appendix describes a Class II reference duration but divides by the combined Class 0/I/flat/II population; the implemented normalization needs clarification.
The text applies a gas-to-dust ratio to obtain disk mass, while the table labels Mass as disk dust mass; preserve this distinction when reproducing mass plots.
Overlapping eight-source windows are correlated, and the stated binomial uncertainty vanishes at detection fractions zero and one.
Continuum morphology alone does not establish planet formation or uniquely identify the mechanism producing cavities.
Survey-dependent resolution and visual classification can leave residual detection incompleteness after the stated cuts.
